description: Recommend PCB glass-weave (fiber-weave) styles for the current design: ranks catalogued styles by impedance variation and cost for the design frequency and marks the cheapest one meeting the impedance tolerance. Reuses the Phase-24 engine behind POST /api/glass-weave/recommend. Frequency is derived from the solved stackup / RF specs; tolerance and trace width default to stated assumptions — call with no arguments once a design exists.

frequency_ghz.description: Optional. Design frequency in GHz. Derived from the solved stackup / RF specs when omitted.

impedance_tolerance_pct.description: Optional impedance tolerance target in percent (default 5).

is_differential_pair.description: Optional. True halves the effective tolerance (differential pairs are more skew-sensitive). Default false.

trace_width_mm.description: Optional trace width in mm (default 0.1, worst-case narrow).

user_request.description: The end user's own words that prompted this call, verbatim. Used to verify that the figures you pass were stated by your user rather than inferred. Omit it and the results will be labelled caller-asserted.

name: run_glass_weave_analysis
title: Recommend a PCB glass-weave style
